items.name: Salt Lake Community College Aerospace Engineering Training Center - Utah Public Art
items.shortDescription: Request for qualifications from artists and/or artist teams interested in creating site-specific artwork(s) for the Salt Lake Community College Aerospace Engineering Training Center. Professional artists and artist teams residing in Utah, Arizona, Colorado, Idaho, New Mexico, Nevada, and Wyoming are eligible for this commission.

items.name: Art Exposed Old Town 2027-2029
items.shortDescription:
The City of Florence seeks eight vibrant sculptures for Historic Old Town on the Oregon Coast. 

The 2027-2029 cycle of the Art Exposed Rotating Outdoor Art Gallery will install eight vibrant sculptures in Historic Old Town Florence through Art Exposed Old Town. Once selected, the art is scheduled to be installed in February 2027 and be on display through 2029.

Artists can apply until December 4, 2026, through Call for Entry (CaFÉ). There is a $25.00 application fee. Chosen artists will receive a stipend of $1,500.00 and the chance to show their work to thousands of people who visit or live on the central Oregon Coast.

items.name: SCULPTURE WALK AT TUSTIN LEGACY PARK
items.shortDescription:
The Tustin Public Art Commission invites artists to submit completed sculptures for the inaugural biennial Tustin Legacy Sculpture Walk exhibition to be installed in summer 2027.  The goal of this national juried exhibit of original three-dimensional art is to present works from artists who wish to have their pieces displayed in an outdoor setting that draws art lovers into the recently re-conceptualized environment of Tustin Legacy Park.

Five sculptures will be selected:

  • Three sculptures will receive a $7,500 honorarium for a three-year exhibition
  • Two sculptures will receive a $5,000 honorarium for a two-year exhibition

items.name: Lewisville Grand Theater Courtyard Rotating Sculpture Program
items.shortDescription:
The City of Lewisville, Texas is seeking artwork submissions from artists who wish to exhibit outdoor sculptures as part of a rotating sculpture program in the courtyard of the Lewisville Grand Theater. All sculptures must be family appropriate and pose no risk to public safety. 

For this inaugural year of the program, the Arts Advisory Board will select three sculptures for a two-year exhibition opportunity.

Following the success of the inaugural year of this rotating sculpture program, the Arts Advisory Board will select three sculptures for a two-year exhibition opportunity.  The City of Lewisville will award a $2,000 honorarium for each sculpture selected for the two-year term for the installation, exhibition, and removal of the artwork.

Sculptures will remain under the artist’s ownership, loaned to the City of Lewisville.

This program is open to regional artists only, in the TX-OK-AR-LA region.

items.name: "Art Is: South Dakota" Juried Exhibition
items.shortDescription:
Brief:

Artists currently living in South Dakota, as well as enrolled citizens of one of the state’s federally recognized tribes, are invited to submit artworks for consideration for Art Is: South Dakota. This competitive exhibition is designed to broaden inclusion and access, creating opportunities for artists at every stage of their careers to share their work with audiences throughout the state.

Organized around the open-ended prompt Art Is…, the exhibition welcomes artists to express what art means to them through their work and a short artist statement. A competitive juried process will bring together a wide range of perspectives, media, experiences, and creative practices that reflect the people and places of South Dakota.

Selected artworks will travel to five exhibiting institutions across the state, connecting artists with new communities and giving audiences in different regions opportunities to encounter contemporary art made by South Dakota artists.

items.shortDescription:

items.name: Corey Area Winter Art & Craft Festival January 2027
items.shortDescription:
The charming Corey Avenue district is set to be transformed once again as the Corey Avenue Art & Craft Festivals return for their 33rd annual season.

This popular, long-running tradition transforms the historic Corey Avenue—the cultural and social "heart" of downtown St. Pete Beach—into a lively, open-air marketplace. The avenue is celebrated for its unique blend of "Old Florida" charm and vibrant community, featuring a mix of local businesses and rich history.

Hosted by the Corey Area Business Association (CABA), these multi-day festivals are a highlight—a must-visit for tourists, art lovers, and collectors seeking handcrafted treasures. For over three decades, the events have brought world-class artistry to the neighborhood, driving economic activity for exhibitors and local businesses.

Visitors are invited to stroll the avenue, meet talented exhibitors, and support the diverse array of small businesses, boutiques, and locally owned restaurants that collectively make Corey Avenue unique.

Join us on Corey Avenue for these Additional 2027 dates:
April 10-11 / June 5-6 / October 9-10 / December 4-5

All events are pet and family friendly, and admission is FREE.

items.name: Coquina Beach Seafood & Music Festival January 2027 (Paragon Festivals)
items.shortDescription:
Join us on January 22-24, 2027, for the 5th Annual Coquina Beach Seafood & Music Festival!

This event will be held at beautiful Coquina Beach on Anna Maria Island. Festival hours are Friday 4 pm-10 pm (Friday evening is optional for all vendors), Saturday 11 am-10 pm (Saturday 6 pm-10 pm is optional for all vendors), and Sunday 11 am-6 pm.

This vibrant event combines live music, freshly prepared seafood, and a boutique-style Arts & Crafts Market, creating a fun and memorable experience for thousands of attendees.

 

Paragon events are always about Originality • Quality • Boutique

items.name: St. Johns River Festival of the Arts Inc. 2027
items.shortDescription:
The St. Johns River Festival of the Arts invites artists to apply for the Fifteenth Annual Juried Fine Art and Fine Craft Festival in Historic Downtown Sanford, Florida, on April 24–25, 2027.

The festival takes place along charming brick streets lined with galleries, boutiques, cafés, pubs, and restaurants in one of Central Florida's most vibrant downtown districts.

The event offers $15,500 in artist awards and attracts approximately 60,000 visitors throughout the weekend. A comprehensive marketing campaign promotes the festival throughout Central Florida using television, radio, print, billboards, digital advertising, event calendars, and social media.

Booth fees are $275 for First Street and $235 for Side Street, plus a $25 application fee. First Street spaces are limited and typically fill early.

New for 2027, the festival will introduce an Emerging Artist Program. Six emerging fine artists or fine craft artists who successfully complete the jury process will be selected to exhibit on Side Street at a reduced booth fee, providing an opportunity to gain experience exhibiting in a professionally juried festival environment.

Artists enjoy convenient load-in and load-out, setup on Friday afternoon/evening or early Saturday morning, complimentary breakfasts and lunches in the Artist Retreat, booth sitters, and water service during festival hours.

Join us for an outstanding weekend of fine art and warm hospitality in beautiful Historic Downtown Sanford.

items.name: Punta Gorda Seafood & Music Festival January 2027 (Paragon Festivals)
items.shortDescription:
Join us for the 5th Annual Punta Gorda Seafood & Music Festival, taking place January 15–17, 2027!

This popular three-day event features live music, arts & crafts, and freshly prepared seafood, creating a vibrant community celebration. The festival attracts visitors from across southwest Florida, including Fort Myers, Cape Coral, Port Charlotte, Venice, Englewood, and Sarasota, making it a fantastic opportunity to grow your client base and reach new customers.


 

                                                 Paragon Events: Original – Quality – Boutique

items.name: St. Petersburg Fine Art Festival February 2027 (Paragon Festivals)
items.shortDescription:
Join us for the 13th annual St. Petersburg Fine Art Festival.  This fine art festival takes place at the beautiful venue of South Straub Park in the Waterfront Arts District in downtown St. Petersburg, across the street to the south of the Museum of Fine Arts - St. Petersburg. 

Dates this year are February 6-7, 2027. The event has been consistently strong across all art mediums since 2014. The event was rated number 9 in USA Today’s top 100 Art Shows 2024!

For the past several years St. Petersburg has been named the #1 arts destination for mid-sized American cities. The St. Petersburg Fine Art Festival is located between Beach Drive NE and Bayshore Drive NE overlooking Tampa Bay. Within walking distance of numerous museums, galleries, cultural venues, shops, and restaurants.

            Paragon events are always about Original - Quality - Boutique

items.name: Lakewood Ranch Festival of the Arts March 2027 (Paragon Festivals)
items.shortDescription:
Join us for the 9th Annual Lakewood Ranch Festival of the Arts, happening March 6 and 7, 2027, on charming Main Street in downtown Lakewood Ranch, Florida.

Setup will take place on Saturday, March 7, from 5:00 a.m. to 9:00 a.m. Show hours are 10:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. on both Saturday and Sunday. Admission is free and open to the public.

Lakewood Ranch is one of the most desirable communities in Florida, with residents enjoying a combined annual income of over $100,000. The event is located near the University Town Center shopping district, which features more than 200 stores and restaurants. Local attractions include the Sarasota Polo Club, the Sarasota International Cricket Club, eighteen tennis courts, and numerous golf courses. In addition, Lakewood Ranch is recognized as the largest certified green community in the United States, making it a perfect setting for a high-quality fine art festival that attracts a sophisticated and engaged audience.
 

 

                                           Paragon Festivals: Original - Quality - Boutique!

items.name: Wellen Park Fine Art Festival February 2027 (Paragon Festivals)
items.shortDescription:
Join us for the 3rd annual Wellen Park Fine Art Festival, set amidst the beautiful Downtown Wellen Park in Venice, Florida.

This event will take place on February 13-14, 2027, showcasing the finest in original artwork from talented artists across various mediums. 

Wellen Park is a vibrant, master-planned community and one of the fastest-growing in the U.S., known for its scenic trails, upscale dining, and lively Downtown district. With a median household income of approximately $99,600, it offers an ideal setting for a fine art show that draws a sophisticated and engaged audience.


            Paragon events are always about Original - Quality - Boutique

items.name: Downtown Palm Beach Gardens Art and Craft Festival (Palm Beach Gardens, FL) February 2027 ACE
items.shortDescription: Downtown at the Gardens is a bustling shopping hub situated in the center of Palm Beach Gardens. Featuring numerous large retail stores and a variety of well-liked restaurants, it is guaranteed to attract shoppers. Positioned off Alt A1A and in proximity to the Garden Malls, this picturesque venue is ideal for hosting an Art and Craft festival. The setup primarily occurs on concrete, lining the pathway between shops and eateries. You can easily drive up to your booth. Notable establishments include Cheesecake Factory, Avocado Cantina, Voodoo Bayou, and others. There is also a busy Whole Foods, REI, and various boutique shops.

items.name: Punta Gorda Sullivan Street Craft Festival: January 2027 American Craft Endeavors
items.shortDescription: Nestled by the shores of the Peace River and the Gulf of Mexico in Southwest Florida is the charming city of Punta Gorda, frequently referred to as the heart of Charlotte County. Positioned between Sarasota and Fort Myers on Florida's western coastline, this event has evolved into a beloved winter tradition along Sullivan Street in Downtown Punta Gorda, consistently attracting a large purchasing audience.

items.name: Pinecrest Gardens Art and Design Fair 2027
items.shortDescription:
Celebrate creativity in the very place where South Florida’s story first spread its wings. Inspired by the vibrant legacy of the historic Parrot Jungle, the annual Pinecrest Gardens Art & Design Fair transforms the Gardens into an immersive, open-air celebration of art, design, and imagination.

Wander beneath a lush tropical canopy as you explore a thoughtfully curated mix of contemporary art, handcrafted works, and innovative design from artists, artisans, and makers from across the region and beyond. Drawing inspiration from the spirit of America’s most beloved art fairs, this year’s experience blends the whimsy and wonder of Parrot Jungle with the energy of a modern creative marketplace—where every path reveals something unexpected.

Whether you’re a seasoned collector, a design enthusiast, or simply looking for a beautiful day outdoors, the Pinecrest Gardens Art & Design Fair offers a uniquely South Florida experience where art, nature, and history converge.

items.name: Boca Raton Art and Craft Festival at Town Center Mall February 2027 Boca Raton, FL American Craft
items.shortDescription: We are set to return to the Town Center Mall in February for a fantastic art and craft festival. This event will be held at the same venue as January's famous Boca Fest. The Town Center at Boca Raton is recognized as one of South Florida's top luxury shopping destinations and serves as a major attraction in Boca. It features a wide range of specialty shops, fine dining options, and plenty of parking. The show also has a convenient Friday set up.

items.name: Sarasota Festival of the Arts February 2027 (Paragon Festivals)
items.shortDescription:
Join us for the 5th annual Sarasota Festival of the Arts, downtown Sarasota on February 27-28, 2027!

This event will be held at JD Hamel Park in beautiful downtown Sarasota. This boutique show features under 100 juried artists and welcomes an engaged, art-loving audience that supports a wide variety of mediums.

Patrons are inquisitive, inspired, and purchase all art mediums. The Sarasota Festival of the Arts remains a strong and growing fine art festival that has steady crowds from start to finish each year providing strong sales. 
  

 

                   Paragon events are always about:  Original  -  Quality  -  Boutique!

items.name: Lakewood Ranch Fine Art Festival January 2027 (Paragon Festivals)
items.shortDescription:
Join us for the 9th annual Lakewood Ranch Fine Art Festival! This event will be held on Main Street in downtown Lakewood Ranch, FL January 23-24, 2027. Setup starts on Saturday, January 23th from 5 am- 9 am with show hours being Saturday 10 am - 5 pm and Sunday 10 am-5 pm. 

Event admission for the public is free. This event was featured in Sunshine Artists "top 100" for 2025.

Residents in the Lakewood Ranch community have a combined annual income of over $100,000, which makes this an ideal location for an art festival. The University Town Center Market is nearby, with over 200 stores. The Sarasota Polo Club plays in Lakewood Ranch, as well as the Sarasota International Cricket Club, and the community boasts eighteen tennis courts and numerous golf courses.  In addition, Lakewood Ranch is the largest certified green community in the United States.

                                                 Paragon Festivals: Original - Quality - Boutique!

items.name: Sanibel Captiva Rotary Arts and Crafts Festival 2027
items.shortDescription:
This highly regarded juried festival offers you the opportunity to present your fine art and fine crafts in an idyllic setting during the busiest time of the winter season. President’s Day weekend is the pinnacle of our busy winter tourist season. Visitors from all over the world crowd Sanibel’s internationally famous pristine white sand beaches, including the affluent, sophisticated art buyers you will meet at the Art Festival. This is a great opportunity to share your art with folks who will truly value and treasure it for years to come. Sanibel and Captiva Islands rank among the nation’s top destinations for upper-income visitors and seasonal residents. The consistently high quality of the work exhibited at the Art Festival attracts knowledgeable art lovers and buyers. This festival has all the characteristics for success: location, venue, audience and ambiance equal to the top-ranked outdoor shows nationwide!

This show is a fundraising project of the Rotary Club of Sanibel-Captiva.  There are no professional promoters involved and is conducted by a 100% volunteer crew.  ALL net proceeds go to charity.

items.name: Craft Objects & Design Atlanta 2027
items.shortDescription:
Discover the creative spirit of Atlanta at the American Craft Council’s newest fair.

From beautifully crafted objects to forward-thinking design, discover the creative energy shaping today’s handmade culture at Craft Objects & Design Atlanta. This vibrant, all-ages fair will bring together makers, designers, and creative studios from across the country alongside Atlanta-based and regional arts organizations.

This fair will celebrate the powerful intersection of craft and design while building connections between the city and the nation’s creative community. Attendees will explore thoughtfully designed furniture, fashion, jewelry, and home goods, meet the artists and designers behind the work, enjoy hands-on activities, and enjoy craft food, beer, and wine.

Participation is open to artists and makers from across the country who create work that reflects the diversity of contemporary craft. Apply now to participate in this opportunity to share your story and sell your work to ACC’s audience of craft enthusiasts and supporters.

Please review our Zapplication Guide for Artists for instructions on completing your application.

items.name: We Made This Art Fair 2027
items.shortDescription:
We Made This: An Art Fair Celebrating the Creative Power of Women
Join us on Saturday, March 6 (12–6pm) and Sunday, March 7 (10am–4pm) at The Machine Shop in Northeast Minneapolis for a vibrant, two-day art fair honoring Women’s History Month.

Discover the work of over 65 women and gender-expansive artists, explore hands-on creative activities, and enjoy a weekend of inspiration, community, and connection in one of Minneapolis’ most iconic venues.

Free to attend. All are welcome.
Learn more at WeMadeThisArtFair.com
Produced by Homespun Events.

items.name: 89th Annual Student Show in Memory of Judy Christofolis
items.shortDescription:
The 89th Annual Student Show in memory of Judy Christofolis is the largest juried exhibition of work made by the students of the Indy Art Center.

Each year, more than 400 works are submitted, and only some of the works are selected by the judges to be displayed. The result is a breathtaking sampler of creativity and skilled artistic work from all walks of life, spanning years and years of art education inside the Indy Art Center building.

The 89th Annual Student Show juror will be Allison Baker, Associate Professor of Fine Art - Sculpture at Herron School of Art + Design at Indiana University, Indianapolis.

items.name: Make it Midwest: A Regional Exhibition
items.shortDescription:
The Fishers Art Center is calling for entries for artists in any medium 18 or older living in the Midwest for a Juried Exhibition. Artists currently working in Indiana, Ohio, Illinois, Michigan, Kentucky, Missouri, Iowa, Wisconsin, Minnesota, Kansas, or Nebraska are eligible.

This exhibition seeks to highlight the richness found in contemporary Midwest makers and the wide variety of techniques, styles, and aesthetics of the region. The intention of this exhibition is to feature works in a variety of media ranging from traditional processes to contemporary and new media processes.

items.name: SPACE: Exterus Spatium
items.shortDescription:
Outer SPACE: Exterus Spatium A Call for Outer Space Related Artwork

Crooked Tree Arts Center invites artists to explore the space beyond our planet.

An open call to all artists of the United States for outer space related artwork. Anything about the moon, the planets, the stars, the solar systems, the galaxies and beyond is welcome. Work can be literally about these celestial bodies, and/or their effects upon our Earth. Science fact or science fiction based material are equally encouraged.

All media are welcome, except AI.

items.name: Ephemeral Beauty- 2027 Juried Art Exhibit
items.shortDescription:
Kahilu Exhibits seeks artwork for our 2027 Juried Art Exhibition, Ephemeral Beauty. This exhibition will be on view January 14, 2027 through February 28, 2027 in Kahilu’s Simperman and Suli T. Go Galleries in Waimea, Hawaiʻi Island.

Guest Juror, Andrzej Kramarz (Gallery Director - East Hawaiʻi Cultural Center, Hilo), invites artists to submit artworks that investigate the quiet paradox at the heart of our relationship with flowers.

items.name: Reflections
items.shortDescription:
Open to artists in the United States!
READ FULL PROSPECTUS BEFORE ENTERING
Over $300 in cash prizes!
Juror: Katie Trinkle Legge www.katietrinklelegge.com/
Theme: Reflections 
This show will be taking place online only

Exhibition Dates: December 5th - January 8th
Fee: $15 per entry for non-members, $10 per entry for members

items.name: Arizona Aqueous XLI
items.shortDescription:
Arizona Aqueous XLI is a National Juried Exhibition of water-based media on paper.

Water-based pigments on paper must constitute the major portion of the work.  Entries composed of paper constructions, paper sculpture, paper collage, cut paper, mobiles, two- or three-dimensional wall pieces, and installations are eligible.  Water-based inks, acrylics, watercolor, and other water-based media are eligible. Artists are urged to enter work, which is innovative in concept and approach, whether representational or abstract.  Work must have been completed within the last 24 months.  Work that has been previously displayed at TCA is not eligible.  All work must be the original creation of the artist.

items.name: RED
items.shortDescription:
At Hera Gallery we are seeing R.E.D.: red lines, red tape, red hats,  red flags ….. Red as an energetic and aggressive primary color.  Red as mysterious, fiery, intense and emotional. Red as a symbol of passion, war, hate, and love. 

 

Hera Gallery is looking for 52 selections of R.E.D. artwork for our 5th annual international open call virtual exhibition. The selected works will speak to the  range of symbols and emotions the color red represents, specifically in conversation with current political and cultural states. 

 

The exhibition will take place throughout the year of 2027. All selected works will be on virtual display throughout the duration of the exhibition on heragallery.org. Each week, Hera Gallery will choose one featured artist and their work from the exhibition to be posted on all Hera Gallery’s social media accounts. Stay tuned for more information about the upcoming virtual artist talk.

items.name: 3rd Gonzaga Triennial: Inland Northwest Juried Landscape Art Exhibition
items.shortDescription:
3rd Gonzaga Triennial: Inland Northwest Juried Landscape Art Exhibition

May 22 to August 28, 2027

In the summer of 2027, the Jundt Art Museum at Gonzaga University presents the 3rd Gonzaga Triennial: Inland Northwest Juried Landscape Art Exhibition, organized by the staff of the museum.  

This juried display, occurring at Gonzaga University every third summer, seeks to present the diversity and dynamism of contemporary artistic activity in the Inland Northwest while celebrating the relationship between art and the local landscape.

items.name: 2027 Open Studio Tour
items.shortDescription: The Open Studio Tour is a marketing opportunity for serious professionals and a supportive environment to nurture and present new and emerging artists. This Tour extends from Nogales in the south to Sahuarita in the north along the I-19 interstate.

items.name: 2027 International Juried Ceramics Exhibition
items.shortDescription:
The Center for Contemporary Art’s annual International Juried Exhibition celebrates contemporary art by both established and emerging artists. The Center for Contemporary Art (“The Center”) is a vibrant regional non-profit art center with studio art classes, a summer art camp, rotating exhibitions and community partnership programs. 

Juror Jack Troy will select work for inclusion in the exhibition and for three cash prizes. The Center’s Exhibitions Committee will review the body of work of each artist selected and choose up to three for a solo exhibition in 2028.

items.name: Downtown Palm Beach Gardens Fine Art Festival January 2027 Howard Alan Events
items.shortDescription: Celebrate the New Year at Downtown at the Gardens! This vibrant shopping destination is in the heart of Palm Beach Gardens with a variety of expansive retail stores and a choice of well-loved dining spots. Located just off Alt A1A and near the Garden Malls, this delightful venue is ideal for hosting fine art events. Notable establishments include the Cheesecake Factory, Avocado Cantina, and Voodoo Bayou, among others. Furthermore, there is a lively Whole Foods, REI, and an assortment of boutique shops. The autumn and spring art fairs have received substantial support from both the city and the management complex, resulting in the addition of this January event to launch the winter season.

items.name: 2027 Sculpture Walk - Lee's Summit, MO
items.shortDescription:
Call for Artists Summary

The City of Lee’s Summit (MO) Cultural Arts Division is accepting applications for the Downtown Sculpture Walk. The exhibit will run from Late April 2027 – May 2028. The submission deadline is the end of day on January 22, 2027.

Six (6) artists will be selected to install 3D sculptural works appropriate for the one-year outdoor display.

Lee’s Summit is a southeast suburb of Kansas City, Missouri. The Downtown Sculpture Walk is open to professional artists at least 18 years of age. Artwork must be of original work and be complete by the time the application is submitted. Design concepts will not be accepted.

Selected artists will receive an all-inclusive $2,000 stipend to offset costs associated with installation, travel, and per diem.

Artists receive 100% of the sale of artwork sold.

items.name: Between Seasons: Black & White Photography from City to Sea Open Call
items.shortDescription:
Between Seasons: Black & White Photography from City to Sea is an annual juried, in-person fine art photography exhibition held at the Southampton Cultural Center in Southampton, New York.

Only 40 photographs will be selected for this exclusive exhibition, celebrating the artistry and creative vision of black-and-white photography.

Jurors: Joanne Henig and Jessica Lempin 
The top 40 photographs will be selected through a blind jury process, ensuring each image is evaluated on its artistic merit, originality, composition, and visual impact.

Awards: Cash awards will be announced and presented during the in-person artist reception on Saturday, March 27, 2027, from 12:00–2:00 PM.

Application Requirements: For the initial CaFÉ submission, we only require the title of each photograph along with its uploaded digital image. Additional artwork details will be requested from selected artists following acceptance.

Important: This is an in-person exhibition.

items.name: The PASEO 2027 Biennial Outdoor Art Festival, Taos, NM
items.shortDescription:
The PASEO 2027 Biennial is a festival dedicated to bringing the art of installation, performance and projection to the streets of Taos, New Mexico. This two-day outdoor event, set in the high desert of Taos, New Mexico, is bringing its twelfth festival to the streets, Friday and Saturday evening, September 17th and 18th, 2027.

The PASEO 2027 Biennial is seeking work that is immersive, participatory, and/or will make a dynamic impact within the Taos Historic District of Taos, New Mexico, USA. The PASEO 2025 Festival brought thousands of people to the historic downtown of Taos, to experience this annual celebration. 

Additionally, Artists are encouraged to share their process of art-making with the Taos community. As part of the application process artists are invited to submit proposals for adult and youth workshops, lectures and forums.

Applicants are encouraged to respond to the 2027 theme: Convergence

items.name: City of Fremont boxART! Program
items.shortDescription:
Calling Artists for Fremont’s boxART! Program!
Help bring more art to Fremont! The City of Fremont invites professional artists to submit proposals for the next phase of boxART!, a public art program that transforms traffic signal control boxes into beautiful painted works of art. Bay Area and local artists are especially encouraged to apply.
This year’s theme, “Creating Exceptional Experiences,” invites artists to share what makes Fremont a meaningful place to live, work, and play. Designs may draw inspiration from the people, places, and everyday experiences that bring our community together. The call is open through November 15, 2026.

NOTE: Your proposal must use the City-provided boxART! template.

items.name: Sugar House State Liquor Store - Utah Public Art
items.shortDescription: Request for qualifications from Utah artists and/or artist teams interested in creating site-specific artwork(s) for the Sugar House State Liquor Store. Professional artists and artist teams residing in Utah are eligible for this commission.

items.name: Art in Public Buildings: Sheridan College Science Center Addition
items.shortDescription: Sheridan College has started a renovation and addition of the Science Center on campus in Sheridan, WY. This project falls within the jurisdiction of the Art in Public Buildings Program, a percent-for-art initiative for qualifying projects in Wyoming. Artists are asked to submit examples of completed work and to demonstrate their interest and ability to complete a public art project. Submissions to the RFQ will be reviewed by committee and the selected finalists will be invited to submit a full proposal. This is a regional call for qualifications only open to artists in the following states: Montana, Idaho, Utah, Wyoming Colorado, Arizona, Nevada, New Mexico. Wyoming artists will be given preference.

items.name: Garrison Art Center 2028 Exhibition Season
items.shortDescription: We accept applications for solo, two- and three-person, and small-curated group shows.

items.name: CCA Call for Exhibition Proposals 2026
items.shortDescription: Coconino Center for the Arts in Flagstaff, AZ invites exhibition proposals from artists, curators, and cultural organizations.

items.name: Sculpture Tucson 2027 Sculpture Festival Show & Sale
items.shortDescription:
Arizona’s largest sculpture festival, the Sculpture Tucson Festival Show & Sale, returns March 5–7, 2027, at Brandi Fenton Memorial Park in Tucson, Arizona. This premier three-day event showcases outstanding contemporary sculpture by regional and national artists in a welcoming outdoor setting. Visitors can meet and engage directly with artists, experience large-scale sculpture, and purchase works of all sizes for private and public collections.

Now celebrating its 11th year, Sculpture Tucson continues its commitment to making sculpture accessible to the community and visitors through free admission, educational opportunities, and a vibrant marketplace connecting artists, collectors, and the public.

items.name: Call For Artists: San Rafael Temporary Sculpture Exhibition
items.shortDescription: The City of San Rafael and San Rafael Arts invite artists and artist teams to apply for a one-year sculpture exhibition in the city’s Arts District. We are seeking one (1) existing medium- or large-scale sculpture to be featured prominently at the front entrance of City Hall from August 2027 to August 2028. Downtown San Rafael is proudly designated as one of California's official Cultural Districts by the California Arts Council.

items.name: Art Around the Corner 2027/2028 Outdoor Sculpture Gallery
items.shortDescription: The Art Around the Corner Foundation (AACF) is a nonprofit organization dedicated to supporting the arts, enriching the community, and bringing fine art to Southern Utah. Since 2004, AACF has selected and installed approximately 35 new works of public art each year throughout St. George, Utah. Artists from across the country participate in AACF’s annual Outdoor Sculpture Gallery, with all sculptures available for sale or lease to public and private collectors. To date, the program has generated more than $1 million in art sales.

items.name: City of Newport South Beach Pathway Sculptures
items.shortDescription: Oregon Coast Council for the Arts (OCCA) is to commission 8 permanent sculptures for the South Beach Placemaking Project for the City of Newport, Oregon. Budget is $10,000 for each sculpture. This opportunity is open to artists with public art sculpture experience, with preference for those located in the Pacific Northwest.

items.name: The Clarence Love Legacy Project – Love Park
items.shortDescription:
The Bradenton Community Redevelopment Agency seeks proposals from artists residing or working in Manatee, Sarasota, Pinellas, or Hillsborough County, Florida for a permanent outdoor artwork at Love Park (118 11th Ave W). The project honors Clarence Love, Bradenton’s first Black councilman, celebrating his legacy while elevating the park as a space for reflection and community pride.

Budget: $85,000 all-inclusive (design, fabrication, delivery, installation).

Eligibility: Minimum 5 documented works of similar scale/cost.

Resources: CRA park redesign plans and Love family archival recordings are available upon request.

Requirements: CV, 5-work portfolio, concept narrative, visual renderings, materials/maintenance plan, timeline, and inter-agency coordination outline.

items.name: Art Benches at Coral Reef Park Call to Artist
items.shortDescription: The Village of Palmetto Bay desires to select four (4) artists with proposals to design art benches that embodies the family-friendly, vibrant, peaceful, lush nature of Coral Reef Park. A total of four (4) design proposals will be selected by the AIPP Board to be recommended to the Village Council. More than one (1) design may be submitted by each artist in the application.

items.name: Hopkins ArtStreet 27-28
items.shortDescription: Hopkins ArtStreet is a select, juried public art display centered on charming, historic Mainstreet in Hopkins, MN (15 minutes from downtown Minneapolis). Artists working in all outdoor-tolerant media are invited to apply. Accepted artwork is displayed for approximately one year (May to May), is eligible for consideration for cash awards, and will be considered for purchase.

items.name: Call for Artist-Designed Entrance Feature
items.shortDescription:
Noerenberg Gardens is seeking proposals for an artist-designed entry feature to be installed in Fall 2027. Located near the entrance to the parking lot, it will serve as a welcoming landmark. Beyond identifying the gardens, the design should reflect the beauty, history, and distinctive character of the site while inviting curiosity and exploration. 

One proposal will be selected and awarded a $20,000 honorarium to support the design, fabrication, and installation of the piece.  

Site Visit: Sunday, November 8 from 1 – 2:30 pm.   

Application Deadline: December 15, 2026

items.name: 2027 Mountain Maryland Plein Air
items.shortDescription:
The Mountain Maryland Plein Air juried competition and exhibition will be presented and
managed by the Allegany Arts Council. The event, now in its 14th year, will feature our
refreshed downtown with paintings installed at the beautiful Allegany Museum.

This competitive event is a hallmark of the Western Maryland art scene. Located in the
Appalachian Mountains, the area is resplendent with magnificent vistas, pristine state forests
and historic architecture. The Western Maryland Scenic Railroad adds to the small-town, turn-
of-the-century charm; and the C&O Canal, a working railroad yard, abandoned industrial sites,
farms, lakes and trout streams collectively provide something of interest for every artist.

Up to thirty artists will be invited to participate for awards totaling almost $14,000.

items.name: The 2027 Southern Miss National Poster Show
items.shortDescription:
Call for Entries

The University of Southern Mississippi invites professional and emerging artists, graphic designers, illustrators, and printmakers to submit original poster designs for the 2027 Southern Miss National Poster Show.

Centered around the theme Social Advocacy, this national juried exhibition celebrates the poster's unique ability to communicate powerful ideas through compelling visual design. Throughout history, posters have served as catalysts for awareness and action, influencing public opinion, supporting social movements, promoting causes, and giving voice to communities around the world.

The Southern Miss National Poster Show seeks work that demonstrates both conceptual strength and excellence in design, recognizing the poster as a medium capable of informing, persuading, provoking thought, and inspiring positive change.

items.name: New Orleans Jazz Fest Volunteer Photography Program 2027
items.shortDescription: The Volunteer Photographer Program is a community outreach project of the New Orleans Jazz & Heritage Foundation’s Archive. The mission of the program is to provide documentation of the New Orleans Jazz & Heritage Festival for the Foundation Archive. NO WATERMARKS ON YOUR IMAGES. Double check all your images as watermark free before submitting.

items.name: 57th Street Art Fair 2027
items.shortDescription:
Celebrate the 80th Annual 57th Street Art Fair June 5 & 6, 2027!

The 57th Street Art Fair is a two-day outdoor celebration of the visual arts held the first full weekend of June in the Hyde Park neighborhood of Chicago, adjacent to the University of Chicago campus. Considered the oldest juried art fair in the Midwest, the goal of the 57th Street Art Fair is to provide a venue for creators of quality fine art and fine craft to meet with the art-buying public.  All artwork displayed at the 57th Street Art Fair must be original and produced entirely by the hands of the exhibiting artist:  no reproductions, unlimited editions, or mass produced work.   No work generated partially or in entirety by or with the aid of Artificial Intelligence is permitted. 

 

Important Dates and Deadlines

November 1, 2026:  Applications open
January 15, 2027:  Deadline for applications
March 1, 2027:  Notification date
April 15, 2027: Deadline for accepted artists to commit to exhibit and to remit booth fee.                                                                                      
April 30, 2027: Deadline to cancel participation and receive full refund of booth fee.

items.name: Artisans' Fair at Gold Rush Days 2027
items.shortDescription:
The annual Gold Rush Days & Artisans' Fair is back! Celebrating Wickenburg's past as a ranching and gold mining center, this popular winter event is held in Wickenburg's historic downtown. This year, this heritage event celebrates its 77th anniversary and will draw tens of thousands of visitors during the 3 days of fun-filled activities. "Gold Rush Days" are recognized by the Library of Congress as one of America's Living Legacies. One comment from artist, Dan Abernathy: says, "The Artisans' Fair during Gold Rush Days is nothing short of fantastic." 

Amenities for the Artisans Fair are:rn
  • Best of Booth cash prizes. 
  • Booth sitting for artisan relief.
  • Complimentary Friday Morning Continental Breakfast.
  • Help with load-in and load-out on a first come first serve basis; vendors must be able to set up and take down their booth. 
  • Town maps and information. 
  • 136 spaces at competitive prices.
  • Citizens’ Patrol security from 7:00 pm Thursday through 7:00 am Sunday.
  • PR Marketing and Advertising in town and surrounding areas.
  • Wi-Fi throughout the grounds. May be limited in some areas. 
  • Electricity is NOT availble. Maybe avaable by special arangement.
  • Designated Vendor and Trailer Parking walking distance to Stone Park.
  • Three Day Town of Wickenburg Sellers Permit is included in your application fee.

items.name: Palm Springs Art Festival - March 6 - 7, 2027
items.shortDescription:
The Palm Springs Art Festival will return on March 6 - 7, 2027,  for its 38th year at Frances Stevens Park in Uptown Palm Springs, California.

We invite you to submit your application for this popular event held in the heart of Palm Springs during the peak Season.

Artwork included in the event is 2 and 3-dimensional mixed media, ceramics, digital, glass, jewelry, metal, paintings, photography, sculpture, and wood..

items.name: Desert Art Festival - February 12 - 14, 2027
items.shortDescription:
The Desert Art Festival, on President's Weekend, a three-day Holiday event. The Desert Art Festival will be held at The River at Rancho Mirage.

One hundred of the finest artists will display their original work in all mediums of fine art and fine craft.

The Desert Art Festival is a three-day outdoor celebration of the visual arts. This event typically features the work of 100 exhibitors. Our goal is to provide a venue for creators of quality fine art and fine craft to meet with the art-buying public.

This show has large established patronage from Canada and the Eastern States (snowbirds) as well as California. 

There is a prior day set up and overnight security. Overnight parking is available at the venue.

Admission and parking are free to the public.

items.name: Worthington Arts Festival 2027
items.shortDescription:
The Worthington Arts Festival is one of Central Ohio’s premier Fine Art festivals. This community event is produced by the McConnell Arts Center in coordination with the City of Worthington. Drawing nearly 30,000 visitors and 120 artists annually, the Worthington Arts Festival builds pathways to experience the joy and wonder of the arts.

We have returned to our roots at our original location on the Worthington Village Green. Located at the intersection of High Street and 161, the festival is featured on all four quadrants of the park and is just a short walk from the businesses and restaurants of historic Old Worthington.

The McConnell Arts Center once again looks forward to bringing our community together to celebrate creative arts experiences during the 2027 Worthington Arts Festival.

items.name: Circle of Art 2027
items.shortDescription:
Showcase and Sell your Fine Art at Soroptimist International's Circle of Art, all while surrounded by the beauty of Southern California's Anza-Borrego Desert State Park!  This singular opportunity to enjoy the mountains, blue sky and springtime beauty of the Anza-Borrego Desert is also a chance to contribute to the empowerment of young women and girls through education via scholarships and other support.

Since 1989, every year in March, Borrego Springs is host to the Circle of Art at Christmas Circle Park in the heart of the village.   This juried fine arts show and sale is free to the public and features over sixty exhibitors; the chosen artists exhibit quality paintings and artworks representing a variety of media including oil and watercolors, photography, sculpture, ceramics, pottery, weaving and jewelry.  
Circle of Art is also the community's oldest non-profit fundraiser. Circle of Art 2026 is sponsored by Soroptimist Int'l of Borrego Springs' (SI Borrego Springs) and all proceeds will go to its mission to transform the lives of women and girls through education, empowerment and enabling opportunities. Locally they provide educational programs and scholarships especially for women residents of the greater Borrego Springs Community.  More information about SI Borrego Springs mission and programs can be found on our website.

items.name: Redlands Festival of Arts 2027
items.shortDescription:
Join us Memorial Day Weekend in beautiful Smiley Park for the 15th Annual Redlands Festival of Arts, taking place Saturday, May 29, and Sunday, May 30, from 10 am to 5 pm each day.

Festival Highlights

  • Juried Fine Art Show
  • Booth Fee Only — No Sales Commission
  • Prime Location Near Downtown Redlands Restaurants and Attractions
  • Beer & Wine Garden, Food Trucks, and Live Entertainment
  • Youth Art Expo
  • Supports Local Youth Arts Education Programs
  • $6,000 in Artist Cash Awards
  • Featuring Both Two- and Three-Dimensional Fine Art

items.name: Art Studio Clearance Sale 2027
items.shortDescription:
Passionate art collectors who love great deals shop the Art Studio Clearance Sale! Clear out your studio and make some quick cash now during pre-show season. BONUS: ART STUDIO CLEARANCE SALE IS THE EASIEST SHOW YOU WILL DO ALL YEAR!
  • Have you been hauling around pieces that can’t seem to find a home?
  • Do you have slightly flawed or discontinued work collecting dust in your studio?
  • Did you unload a kiln only to discover a few firing mishaps?
  • Do you need some quick cash in February?
Amenities Include:
  • Drive inside the building for easy load-in/load-out just a few feet from your booth!
  • Full booth setup is NOT required at this show. Ordering electricity is optional.
  • 24-hour security Friday through Sunday
  • Experienced and knowledgeable staff
  • Volunteers for booth sitting available both days of the show
  • Low booth fees
  • Centrally located at the Ohio Expo Center's Lausche Building
  • Fully stocked ATM available to customers
  • Free coffee/tea service on set-up day

items.name: Celebration Craft Festival February 2027 American Craft Endeavors Celebration Town Center, FL
items.shortDescription: Celebration, Florida, is a thoughtfully designed community that was initially created by The Walt Disney Company, situated only 5 miles south of the Walt Disney World Resort. It serves as a desirable and charming residential neighborhood within the Orlando area. Celebration Town Center offers shopping, dining, outdoor recreation, and entertainment in a walkable setting.

items.name: Coconut Point Art and Craft Festival January 2027 (Estero, FL) 3rd Annual American Craft Endeavors
items.shortDescription: Coconut Point is located between in Estero between Naples and Fort Myers. The property has 1.2 million square feet of retail space, office condos and residential housing. With 113 stores and 25 restaurants - all surrounding several acres of lakes and boardwalk, Coconut Point is the place for people to shop, dine, work, gather and live. The show has a convenient Friday set-up.

items.name: Sun and Shores Art Festival 2027
items.shortDescription:
Join us for the 2nd Annual Sun & Shores Arts Festival, a vibrant, family-friendly weekend celebrating creativity by the sea! Hosted by the City of Daytona Beach Shores, this two-day outdoor festival will feature 75 different artists, along with food trucks, live music, and kids’ activities—all set in a fun, coastal atmosphere.
 

Event Schedule

  • Saturday, February 13: 9:00 AM – 4:00 PM

  • Sunday, February 14: 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM

items.name: Downtown Arts 2027-28
items.shortDescription: Downtown Arts provides support for and generates awareness about members of Greensboro’s visual arts community while enhancing the downtown built environment with original works of art. Selected artists will receive compensation and the support of City of Greensboro led marketing initiatives.

items.name: Waterside Parking Garage Public Art
items.shortDescription: The City of Norfolk, Virginia seeks to commission an artist to create a permanent artwork for the Waterside Parking Garage, a prominent gateway to Downtown and the waterfront. The installation should reflect movement, connection, and the innovative spirit of Norfolk, offering a bold visual landmark for commuters and visitors alike.

items.name: Cape Cod Museum of Art - International Juried Exhibition 2027 "Positive Correlations"
items.shortDescription:
What connects us? What patterns emerge when ideas, experiences, people, events, or observations intersect? Positive Correlations invites artists from around the world to explore the relationships we discover, and the conclusions we draw from them.

A positive correlation can appear hopeful, reinforcing what we believe to be true. But correlation can also expose troubling patterns, challenge assumptions, or provide evidence that causes us to reconsider what we thought we knew. It can help verify an idea, refute it, or open the door to an entirely different understanding.

From science and technology to nature, politics, culture, identity, relationships, economics, history, and everyday life, correlations shape how we interpret our world.

We invite artists working in any medium, perspective, culture, or subject to interpret the theme broadly, personally, playfully, critically, or provocatively.

What connects? What conflicts? What does the evidence reveal?
Show us your Positive Correlations.

....

items.name: True Blue: a Juried Exhibition
items.shortDescription: From the vastness of the sky to the depths of the sea—from loyalty and friendship to sorrow and melancholy—True Blue invites artists to explore the color, symbolism, and emotional resonance of blue.

items.name: THROWING SHADE
items.shortDescription:
Art Fluent invites artists worldwide to submit artwork to our online exhibit, THROWING SHADE.

THEME
Light and shadow speak to the parts of us that words miss. Light reveals, shadow conceals, and in the space between them, mystery and emotion come alive. In any medium, light and shadow guide our attention and shape how we sit with a piece. Show us your version of THROWING SHADE. 

CALENDAR
JPEGs due by Friday, January 8, 2027, at midnight MST.
Notification of acceptance and online gallery opening by Friday, February 5, 2027.

AWARDS
All accepted pieces will be displayed in our online gallery at www.art-fluent.com
Best of Show: $750
Two Director’s Choice awards: $250 each

items.name: What's the Word?: By Us and About Us
items.shortDescription:
The theme of the fourth annual exhibition aligns with the national theme for Black History Month as determined by the Association for the Study of African American Life and History. The 2027 theme explores how African American communication, identity expression, and activism have evolved over time.

NEBAC encourages submissions from visual artists working in any medium--sculptors, photographers, mixed media creators, interdisciplinary artists, and painters.

items.name: Paseo Arts Festival 2027
Piccolo Spoleto Outdoor Art Exhibition 2027 48th-Annual, Charleston, SC
items.shortDescription: The Piccolo Spoleto Outdoor Art Exhibition (PSOAE), voted "Best Art Exhibit" by readers of the Charleston City Paper for the last two years, is the juried 2D visual arts centerpiece of the Piccolo Spoleto Festival. Now in its 48th year, this celebrated 16-day event transforms Marion Square, a historic park in the vibrant heart of downtown Charleston, into a stunning open-air gallery. Held in a city consistently named one of the best travel destinations in the world, the exhibition is a prime destination for the thousands of dedicated art patrons and collectors who travel from across the country and the globe to attend the coinciding and internationally renowned Spoleto Festival USA. After 46 years as an exhibit only open to South Carolina artists, we are proud to announce our national call for entry on Zapplication, inviting artists from across the United States to apply and be part of this beloved, award-winning event.

items.name: Capital Art and Craft Festival – Spring 2027
items.shortDescription:
The Capital Art and Craft Festival, a juried festival, draws buyers from Virginia, Maryland, DC, and beyond. CACF has hosted numerous festivals welcoming thousands of art and craft connoisseurs in search of unique pieces of art for themselves, personal collections, and as gifts. The festival will be held at the New DTC Expo Center in Sterling, VA where artists will engage with a diverse audience of art and fine craft enthusists who are looking to purchase items for personal collections, gifts, fashionable clothing, home decor and more.  The new two level DTC Expo Center is attached to Dulles Town Center which offers plenty of free parking, easy access and of course, Indoors.

Capital Art and Craft Festivals are produced by SPARGO, Inc., the largest, independently owned, full-service event management company in the United States with over 54 years of experience. Our focus is on producing artist-friendly festivals which bring art/craft buyers and our artists together.

items.name: Windermere Art Show 2027
items.shortDescription:
This is the 12th annual Windermere Art Show in Downtown Windermere, Florida. This elite boutique event will showcase 85+ artists from around the country surrounded by music, food and performing arts in a festive atmosphere around the Town Square. Don't miss this amazing event, which promises to be the best ever!
This is a judged art show and prizes are awarded Best in Show, 1st, 2nd, 3rd places.

items.name: St. Clair Art Fair 2027
items.shortDescription:
The 2027 St. Clair Art Fair is Saturday June 26 (10-6) & Sunday June 27 (10-3) in beautiful Palmer Park in St. Clair, Michigan.  Hosted by the St. Clair Art Association (SCAA), a 501(c)(3) non-profit community art association that was established in 1971, the annual juried St. Clair Art Fair is a highly anticipated and well attended event.  Palmer Park is bounded by the St. Clair River  with beautiful views of sailboats, power boats and freighters!  M-29 will be closed to traffic allowing easy access to Palmer Park and Riverview Plaza areas.  Food and beverage vendors will also be available. There is ample free parking.

More than 130 visual artists will be featured with their fine art and craft including paintings, photographs, paper, sculptures, woodwork, pottery, fiber, jewelry and more. In addition, there will be demonstrating artists. 

We welcome all artists to exhibit their work of original concept, design and execution to apply for the Art Fair   Juried cash awards ($3500) will go to artists in diverse categories and include "Best of Show" and the coveted most creative "Winnie Compton Fangman Award". 

The Alice W. Moore Center for the Arts in the Riverview Plaza will be open and hosting the SCAA  "Summer Vibes" ehibit.
  
St. Clair, Michigan is located along the St. Clair River and is an easy 45 mile drive northeast of Detroit (I94-exit 257).  The St. Clair Marina is available to boaters and an easy walk to the art fair.  Come and visit the BluewaterThumbcoast!

items.name: New Orleans Jazz & Heritage Festival presented by Shell - Louisiana Marketplace 2027
items.shortDescription:
The New Orleans Jazz & Heritage Festival presented by Shell is a joyous and spirited celebration showcasing the authentic music and heritage of Louisiana and New Orleans. It began in 1970 when 350 musicians entertained a crowd half that number in New Orleans’ Congo Square. The Festival is one of the most prestigious and well-attended in the nation, attracting hundreds of thousands of people annually.

The Festival is owned by The New Orleans Jazz & Heritage Festival and Foundation, Inc., a Louisiana non-profit corporation organized to preserve and promote the music, arts, culture and heritage indigenous to Louisiana and the New Orleans area. A two-weekend event featuring fourteen stages of music, plus art and traditional food, this outdoor daytime celebration is held on the park-like infield and in the grandstand area of the historic Fair Grounds Race Course. The Craft Fairs present works by Louisiana, national, and international artisans participating in three tented areas – Contemporary Crafts, Louisiana Marketplace, and Congo Square African Marketplace.

The highly competitive juried Louisiana Marketplace, located adjacent to the Louisiana Folklife Village, will feature twelve different artists each weekend. Louisiana artists will exhibit work incorporating indigenous materials and/or imagery reflective of the state's unique cultural or natural landscape.

items.name: Call for Muralists, Street Artists, Fabricators, and Mural Production Specialists
items.shortDescription:
The City of Santa Fe Arts & Culture Department seeks a diverse range of muralists and street artists, as well as large-scale mural or sign fabricators interested in working with artists, to join the Art in Public Places (AIPP) Public Artist Roster.  

We encourage artists working in murals, street art, graphic art, printmaking, illustration, narrative art, wheat-paste, photography, typography, pattern, collage, and other forms of large-scale visual storytelling to apply for inclusion in a roster of artists and creative fabricators for upcoming mural and large-scale public art opportunities throughout Santa Fe.

items.name: 2027 Access/VSA Emerging Young Artists Program: Thrive
items.shortDescription:
Thrive is a juried career development program and exhibition of work by artists with disabilities, ages 16-25. This year’s exhibition asks disabled artists to consider how their life and their art are flourishing. As an artist how is your work evolving and changing? As a disabled person, how are you vigorously developing and growing? Show us your thrive! 
 

Fifteen winning artists each receive a $3,000 financial stipend and have one of their submitted pieces included in an exhibit in Washington, D.C. Winning artists are required to attend virtual workshops (April 3, May 1, and June 5), and a series of all-expenses-paid career development workshops in Washington, D.C. June 14-18, 2027.

This program is funded by U.S. Department of Education under Grant Number H421F240164. For more information, contact The John F. Kennedy Center for the Performing Arts at vsainfo@kennedy-center.org .

items.name: Reflections
items.shortDescription:
Artspiration Frederick is excited to announce a call for artists for Reflections, its first cash & carry art exhibition, on display in the Artspiration Gallery from December 4-20, 2026. Artists are encouraged to explore the theme of reflection in nature, in memory, in self, or in the the world around us.

Artists may submit original work in any visual medium including painting, drawing, photography, printmaking, sculpture, fiber art, ceramics, mixed media, digital art, and other forms of creative expression. The exhibition seeks to showcase a diverse range of artistic voices, perspectives, techniques, and subject matter.

  • Exhibition dates: Dec. 4-20, 2026
  • Deadline for entries: Nov.13, 2026
  • Juror’s Notification emailed: Nov.19, 2026
  • Artists Reception:  Dec. 12, 2026  - 3:00-5:00
  • Drop off accepted works dates:

      • 10:00 - 4:00
  • Shipped works must arrive by: Nov. 30, 2026 (Shipping is at the cost of the artist; return shipping label must be included)
...

items.name: American Wildlife Art Competition & Exhibition 2027
items.shortDescription:
The Arcadian Gallery in Cumberland, Maryland, invites entries for our second American Wildlife Art Competition & Exhibition 2027. This event highlights the beauty of wildlife through original 2D art, sculpture, digital art, and fine art prints. Approximately 70 works will be selected for exhibition in our elegant brick-and-mortar gallery in Cumberland’s revitalized downtown Arts & Entertainment District, an emerging East Coast arts destination near Washington, D.C., Baltimore, and Pittsburgh. About 50 additional works will be selected for an online exhibition; all physically exhibited works will also appear online. Juried by renowned wildlife artist Carel Pieter Brest van Kempen. Awards include $2,500 First Place, Endangered Species Art, Paleoart, and more. Ten percent of Gallery sales commission supports conservation.

Deadline: Feb. 1, 2027
Exhibition: May 7–June 26, 2027
Location: Arcadian Gallery, Cumberland, Maryland
Fees: $30 first entry; $20 each additional entry, up to five total...

items.name: 2027 Bettie Awards
items.shortDescription: The Delaplaine Arts Center's annual Elizabeth Barker Delaplaine Award for Young Artists (the Bettie Award) is open to high school students residing or attending school in Frederick County, Maryland, in grades 9–12 (public, private, or homeschooled). Work selected for this award is on display at the Delaplaine in March and April. The Bettie Award Grand Prize Winner will receive $1,000. All other Bettie Award winners will receive $100.

items.name: Many Countries in One
items.shortDescription:
Art Transcends borders. "Many Countries in One" is a celebration of immigrant artists who enrich the cultural fabric of the United States through their diverse perspectives, stories, and creative visions. We invite artists who were born outside the United States to submit original works that reflect your unique voice and experience. Immigrant artists are encouraged to submit original work in any visual medium, including painting, drawing, photography, printmaking, sculpture, fiber art, ceramics, mixed media, digital art, and other forms of creative expression. The exhibition seeks to showcase a diverse range of artistic voices, perspectives, techniques, and subject matter. Show dates January 1-31, 2027.

Juror/Curator: Cuban-American artist, curator, and critic, F. Lennox Campello. Lenny is a distinguished voice in the DC, Maryland and Virginia arts community, and a long-time advocate for artists.

  • Deadline for entries: December 11, 2026
  • Juror’s Notification emailed December 18, 2026

items.name: Being Seen 2027
items.shortDescription:
"Being Seen 2027"

If a tree falls in a forest, does it make a sound? It does only if there is an observer. Art also needs an observer to truly Be Seen because art is not complete until it connects with the heart and mind of the viewer. Enter your best work to Be Seen at TAG/The Artists Gallery.

items.name: 2027 Emerging Perspectives Exhibition
items.shortDescription: Join us for the 2027 Emerging Perspectives Exhibition which celebrates young adult artists from across the nation. This annual juried exhibition on display in April is open for submissions from artists ages 18–35 in any medium, and is geared toward artists beginning the pursuit of their creative discipline, whether enrolled in art-centered education programs or engaged in their own artistic practice, while taking strides in setting their career paths.

items.name: 41st Annual All-Florida Exhibition
items.shortDescription: This annual show is the most anticipated of the year. As the name suggests, this exhibition features pieces created by artists working in a wide variety of media from all over the 65,000 square miles that make up Florida. The juried entries come together for an award-winning and exciting exhibition representing today’s contemporary Florida artists. The exhibition will be on display at the Alliance for the Arts in Fort Myers from March 5 – 27, 2027.

items.name: The Baker National 2027
items.shortDescription: The Baker National 2027 (February 17– April 9, 2027) presents a national survey of contemporary art in an all-media juried exhibition. Hosted by the Holt Russell Gallery-Baker University in Baldwin City, KS

items.name: Richard Rocco Memorial
items.shortDescription: The Bernalillo County Arts Board solicits a Request for Qualifications (RFQ) for an artist or artist team to create a lifelike outdoor metal sculpture, preferably bronze, featuring the likeness of U.S. Army Chief Warrant Officer Richard Rocco. Rocco, originally from Albuquerque’s South Valley, was an U.S. Army medic that was responsible for saving the lives of several soldiers after his helicopter was shot down during the Vietnam Conflict in 1968. President Gerald Ford presented Rocco the Congressional Medal of Honor, our nation’s highest military honor, in 1974. He was also a recipient of the Bronze Star and Purple Heart. The sculpture will be installed at the Richard Rocco Memorial Park adjacent to the West Side Community Center, located at 1250 Isleta Blvd SW, Albuquerque, NM 87105. The budget for the project is $200,000.00, all-inclusive, to create and install the artwork. The call is open to artists living in the state of New Mexico.

items.name: Piedmont Park Holiday Market (Fifth Annual) 2026, Piedmont Park -Midtown, Atlanta, Ga
items.shortDescription:
Enjoy the hustle and the bustle of the Holiday Season. As we kick off the annual Piedmont Park Holiday Gift show which will be a 2-day outdoor event. With an emphasis on the visual arts and Holiday Gift giving. This event is centered around buying local and supporting local Artists. As the festival season winds down, we know that many times customers wish they had that one last chance to pick up something special for the holiday gift-giving time. The Midtown community of Piedmont Park is considered to be home to one of the largest and most enthusiastic art-buying communities in metro Atlanta. The Piedmont Park Holiday Gift Market creating a new holiday tradition.
 
This event will feature up to 100 handcrafters centered around the holiday spirit of gift giving, which will include painters, photographers, sculptors, leather and metalwork, glass blowers, jewelers, and crafters! 
 
Festival Hours: Saturday 10 am - 5 pm, Sunday 11:00 am – 5:00 pm

items.name: Buckhead Handmade Holiday Gift Market 2026
items.shortDescription:
Located in the heart of Buckhead and is considered to be one of the most prestigious areas and home to one of the most enthusiastic art-buying communities in the Atlanta metro area. Rain or shine, visitors from all over the country enjoy this event.
 
The Buckhead Handmade Holiday Market is a two-day arts outdoor festival, located in Buckhead, Atlanta, this neighborhood is rich in tradition and has one of the highest and richest demographics in metro Atlanta. Featuring approximately 100 painters, photographers, sculptors, metalwork, glass artists, jewelers, and more! The Festival will also offer artist demonstrations and live acoustic music. 
 
The Buckhead Handmade Holiday Market is organized by the Atlanta Foundation for Public Spaces, LLC, and a board of experts in various artistic disciplines, which has a long history of building some of the most notable events in the south with several holding spots in the TOP 100 in the nation.  The festival will uphold the highest standards supporting the arts and offer participating artists the environment to nurture an appreciation for their skills.
 
Festival Hours: Saturday 11:00 am-6:00 pm, Sunday 11:00 am – 5:00 pm

items.name: AJF 2027 LINDA PESHKIN SOLO EXHIBITION AWARD
items.shortDescription:
Applications will be accepted starting September 1, 2026.

The application is via CaFÉ. You've landed on the website of its parent company, Creative West. At the right, you'll see a link to apply on CaFÉ.

PURPOSE OF AWARD

To provide the resources for the development and implementation of a solo exhibition of art jewelry that the artist would not otherwise have the means to undertake. All jewelry artists can apply; applications from artists presenting proposals for their first solo exhibition are encouraged. Artists must demonstrate how this award will impact their professional goals as well as enhance the field of art jewelry.

items.name: Mount Dora Arts Festival 52nd Annual 2027
items.shortDescription:
52nd ANNUAL MOUNT DORA ARTS FESTIVAL  FEB 6 & FEB 7, 2027

Held on the streets of historic downtown Mount Dora, Florida, the Mount Dora Arts Festival consistently ranks in the top 50 BEST Arts Festivals in the United States for artist sales. The event draws more than 150,000 art enthusiasts and collectors from all over the country for the two day event. Located in the heart of central Florida, Mount Dora is just 30 miles north of Orlando. Tour busses bring hundreds of guests from both coasts each day. Extensive marketing includes billboards, radio, print, social media, and TV. Cash awards equal $20,000 for artists in 2D and 3D.

items.name: Handmade Holiday Market 2026
items.shortDescription:
This holiday art show is on November 22, 2026 at the windowed, high-ceilinged Lincolnshire Marriott Resort in Lincolnshire, Illinois! This one-day, indoor art show features up to 70 jewelers, designers, artisans and crafters, and will be marketed as a holiday gift, jewelry, and home decor show just in time for holiday shopping. 

About Lincolnshire: Located about 34 miles north of Chicago, Lincolnshire is a highly-educated community with one of the fastest-growing townships in the country. 29% of the population have incomes over $200,000 and over 45% of residents have a master’s degree or higher. Specialty shops, boutiques, eateries, mixed-use retail, entertainment, hotels, and office developments make Lincolnshire a hub for shopping and relaxing. Lincolnshire is also home to Stevenson High School - one of the top rated schools in the nation - and surrounded by the affluent suburbs of Riverwoods, Bannockburn and Lake Forest.

items.name: Art in the Park Market Common - November 14 and 15 2026
Lights, Shadows, Reflections - 2027 (4th Annual Juried Exhibition, Publication, Sales)
items.shortDescription:
Exhibit and publish art inspired by Lights, Shadows, and Reflections

Gallerium proudly presents Lights, Shadows, Reflections - 2027, the 4th juried annual exhibition, publication, and sales opportunity to express their role in adding the magical quality in art. They bring a piece of art to life and give it soul to evoke emotions and tell a compelling visual story.

Lights, Shadows, and Reflections are an essential part of every artwork. They play a pivotal role in shaping and defining a piece's mood, atmosphere, and tone. The way in which light falls on a subject, the shadows it creates, and the reflections it casts all contribute to the story and meaning behind an artwork.

Last year's exhibition at: https://www.gallerium.art/lights-shadows-reflections-2025
